metadata.title: Marvell, Lumentum Stocks Have Lost $91 Billion. Could Their Merger Fall Apart?<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Marvell and Lumentum Have Lost $91 Billion in Market Value as Merger Doubts Mount
Marvell Technology planned acquisition of Lumentum has helped erase more than $91 billion in their combined market value. But the selloff alone may not derail the deal.
